posts.title: How to Move a Remote Server Between Tailnets (Without Losing SSH Access)
posts.description: Moving a remote machine between two Tailscale networks (tailnets) is a high-stakes operation. Because Tailscale is a single-session service, logging out usually means cutting the very branch you’re sitting on.
